notes.title: Import/Export Drum Kits As Files
notes.notes:
You can export your saved in-game default drum kit to a file. 

You can now have multiple setups, saved to files, or import a setup someone else created.

Save your drum kit in-game and then use the external Drum Builder application included to then export your current drum kit to a file that can be shared or made just for a backup drum kit/setup.

Drum positions, pitch, paint jobs, drum stick positions, main light, position of light bars and active light stand, snare drum SFX + snare drum skin, are all included in the save file. 

To import a drum kit from a file, double kit it, that's it. After... run VRDUS and select the LOAD button in the Drum Builder tab. It will over-write the default kit, be sure to save yours first if you don't want to loose it with the included app... located in /apps in the VRDUS installation directory. 

Beta Drum Builder 9/13/23.

notes.title: Save Drums & Stick Position On Exit. 8/25/23
notes.notes:
You can now save the positions of the default drum kit so you won't have to position it to your liking every time you play. Drum sticks and lighting props will be saved too. Save your setup in the configuration tab under "Drum Builder", click the save icon to save, and load to reload it.

You can exit the game and reload your positioning when you reopen the game later.

notes.title: Now Play Clone Hero Drum Charts. 8/25/23
notes.notes:
The note highway can now play Clone Hero and other similar GH drum chart songs. Just put your Clone Hero songs in VR Drums Ultimate Streamers installation directory under "VRDUS_Data\Music\Songs" and then just select the song in the note highway song browser.

Bonus Update: Now play .ogg and .wav files along with .mp3 in the in-game music player.
